name: FMC for Cancer Reigate 2026
information: Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** **Proceeds from this competition will be donated to [Cancer Research UK](https://www.cancerresearchuk.org/), which funds research into treatments for cancer which will affect 1 in 3 people. Your participation in this competition could be saving lives!** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)
